summary: The vega-plot dashboard is a static SPA (index.html) that reads meta.json, renders tabs from meta.screens[], lazy-loads Vega-Lite JSON per tab, and patches data URLs with the user's Year/Month filter ({{YEAR}}, {{MONTH}} or literal year=/month=).

screen.definition: One tab in the UI = one object in meta.json screens[]
screen.chartSources: Either screen.spec (single path string) OR screen.charts[] (non-empty array); charts wins over spec when present.

chartSpecFile.definition: A Vega-Lite v5 JSON file with data.url pointing at HTTP CSV (typically rsiotmonitor /sql/...)

periodFilter.definition: Global Year + Month controls in index.html
periodFilter.substitution: Before fetch, every url string in the Vega spec tree is patched: {{YEAR}}, {{MONTH}}, and regex year=\d+, month=\d+

lazyLoad.definition: Vega JSON + CSV fetch only when the user activates that tab the first time
lazyLoad.implication: Changing period refetches only charts that already loaded raw spec into memory

createNewGraphic.goal: New visualization from mqtt_hive / SQL CSV
steps: Add data: { url: "http://HOST:PORT/sql/<encoded SQL>", format: { type: csv } }
Use {{YEAR}} and {{MONTH}} in SQL URL where partitions year/month apply
Wire into meta.json: add screens[].spec OR screens[].charts[].spec path
Ensure rsiotmonitor HTTP server exposes /sql and CORS if cross-origin

createNewTabPage.goal: New tab with one or more charts
steps: Append { id, title, spec } or { id, title, charts: [...] } to meta.screens
Use unique id (letters, digits, underscore, hyphen)
Optional layout + charts[].layout for row/half/full/breakBefore per README

checklist: Page served over HTTP not file://
meta.json and Vega JSON paths relative to index.html
CSV URL reachable; CORS allows browser origin
SQL matches hive partitions; {{YEAR}}/{{MONTH}} aligned with SQL

screens[].title: tab label
screens[].spec: relative path to one Vega-Lite file
screens[].charts: array of { id?, title?, spec, layout?, description? }

constraints: Do not assume charts load until tab is opened
Placeholder substitution applies to any key named url nested in Vega JSON
meta.schema.json validates meta.json shape; Vega files are not validated by this repo unless editor uses Vega schema
introHtml and descriptionHtml are trusted HTML — escape user content if generating dynamically
